env.name: BASE_DIR
env.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

env.name: BASE_DIRS
env.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

env.name: CACHE_DIR
env.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

env.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
env.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

env.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
env.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

env.name: RAG_GROUPING
env.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

env.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
env.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

env.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
env.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

env.name: RAG_DEVICE
env.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

env.name: RAG_DTYPE
env.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

env.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
env.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
